title: Versus rules
description: The skirmish rules of one KDF-v-Sarim matchup map (network design §2.2, §2.3; N3 plan Task 1): where each END of the map has its camp, and which zones pay logistics to whoever holds them. Read by @lions/data's `versusMissionOf`, which maps it field for field into the MissionJson shape the runtime already takes -- no objective, trigger, wave or civilian is authored, so `checkEnd` can never end the runtime and the network rule (outcome.ts) decides the match. `ends` are the two anchors `versusAnchors` returns (friendly = seat 0's end, hostile = seat 1's), NOT sides: which faction, and so which side, stands at an end is the room's. `pnpm validate:data` (tools/validate_versus_rules.mjs) holds the cross-file rules the schema cannot see: camp tiles on open ground inside the map and within 6 tiles of the end's anchor, every income zone declared by the map or by this file, no zone name clashing with the map's, exactly one file per faction-matchup map.

id.description: The map id (one file per map).

map.description: A map id in data/maps; must be one of the faction-matchup maps (@lions/net FACTION_MATCHUP_MAPS).

zones.description: Extra zones this file declares beside the map's own, [x, y, w, h] in tiles. A name may not repeat one of the map's.

income_zones.description: Zones that pay logistics per minute to whichever side holds them uncontested (the mission schema's resources.income_zones, copied as is).

camp.description: The end's camp (structure type `camp`, which is not authored): top-left tile and footprint.
